title: Grateful Dead Live at Hofheinz Pavilion on 1972-11-19
source: Recording Info: SBD > Master Reel > Revox A77(Menke) > A77(Pat Lee) > Transfer Info: Technics 1506 w/Lamb Labs Dolby decoder > WAV (24bit/96k) > Apogee Mini Me 24/96 > Apogee Mini DAC monitoring and mastering > FLAC

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 1972 show with a monster Dark Star and a stellar Dolly Parton cover, captured from the soundboard though with slight pitch and noise‑reduction quirks.
ai_review.review: The performance is described as “blistering” with a 20‑minute heavy Dark Star and an unforgettable rendition of "Tomorrow Is Forever," indicating a very high level of band enthusiasm. The recording comes from a two‑generation SBD source using different Dolby decoding equipment, resulting in a good but not pristine sound (minor pitch drift and a hint of noise reduction). Overall the show shines despite these modest technical imperfections.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong, high‑energy musical performance (≈4.5) offset by a soundboard source with extra generation and slight pitch issues (≈3.5); weighted average yields ~4.2.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Two‑generation SBD transfer, different Dolby B decoder than the Miller version; slight speed/pitch discrepancy and a faint “noise‑reduced” character noted by reviewer.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Long, improvisational jams with a strong second‑half focus; the band is clearly having fun and maintains high momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his enthusiastic presence, superb tone, and leading the extended Dark Star jam.
